name: laptop-frame
title: Laptop Frame
description: MacBook-style laptop that opens, runs a dynamic-island notch notification, then dives the camera into the screen until an image or video fills the frame.
docs: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/screens/laptop-frame?ref=cli — pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette and a bare Remotion render is black.
